description: This source file defines a PHP class 'ADODB_odbtp_unicode' that extends the 'ADODB_odbtp' class, adding Unicode support for ODBTP protocol within the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It sets the database type and enables Unicode SQL, and includes constructor logic. The file also manages inclusion of external dependencies and contains licensing and security comments.
